Photograph of the white-border [[They'd Be Crazy To Follow Us (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The photograph was published at the eBay image host; its photographer is unidentified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/EQwAAOSwMK1lxcYa/s-l1600.webp complete obtained card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 × 1600-pixel obtained photograph is retained as the source. Rectangle (255, 380)–(900, 1220) was extracted, with right and bottom coordinates exclusive. It was proportionally downsampled with Pillow Lanczos resampling to 350 × 456 pixels and saved as RGB PNG without inherited metadata. No perspective correction, border painting, badge removal, replacement wording or reconstruction was applied. This is a photographic reproduction, not a facsimile. The photograph's acquisition date does not establish the card's first publication date.
